_source: Hero v2 (row 14c, D-38, 17.10): docs/data/hero-frames.json poured 1:1 (ids added; order = array order; frame 1 = the LCP). Tag rule: line/price/unit null = not shown; price null hides the unit too. Other pages pick a hero photo by id. Before: Hero frames per docs/build-plan.md §3 (files, focal points) and the canvas boards Main/Desktop (zoom origins). Alts NL/RO and tag names NL/RO = lexicon §5.14 table (06.10) verbatim. Tag line and price stay [KOOKLIJN] / [PRIJS] (RO [PREȚ]) until FACTS.md has the owners' values. Claude Code, stage 1. Stage 9 revision (13.10): the RO cooking-line placeholder is [GĂTIRE] (lexicon §5.19 / §6), the NL one stays [KOOKLIJN]. Row 5b (15.10): frame 3 „Hapjes & feestschotels” price = vanaf €1,50 /stuk (RO de la 1,50 € /buc.) — the cheapest hapje of the owners' list (lepeltje paté, [OWNER] 13.10, docs/data/price-list.json); its line stays [KOOKLIJN]. Row 14 (16.10): hero frame 2 = the phone shoot's #16 (pork chops in the counter, docs/data/phone-shoot-slots.json `hero-frame-2-replacement`), white-balanced (display), replaces the old-site pork-products.webp under the same tag; focal 50/55, zoom 50/50, alt as the JSON. Row 14c budget: AVIF quality 45 unless the frame names its own (quality), the highest that keeps the variant served at 412 × 823 @1,75 ≤ 90 kB (sharp, 17.10). Dan 17.10 (13:1x, chat): „take out this photo” — John & Georgiana (frame 3) out of the hero; 9 frames.
